fieldEvidence.measurements: Quick Facts maximum 15 cm TL, depth 0–80 m. Original transcription 16 cm and to 20 m retained in provenance; usual habitat to 20 m distinguished from recorded limit.
fieldEvidence.habitat: Sheltered sand, rubble, mud and weed; singly or pairs.
fieldEvidence.range: Eastern Indo-West Pacific; Australian distribution includes offshore Indian and Pacific islands.

requiredHumanDecisions: Approve Fishes of Australia as authoritative replacement for unavailable original book p. 381 (PDF p. 382), including 15 cm TL / 0–80 m recorded limits versus transcription 16 cm / to 20 m; 20 m describes usual habitat, not maximum occurrence.
